decisions.reason: The vacuum thermoforming unit is close to the core dental equipment offer and has kept a dedicated page for two years, so results appear to meet aspirations and give no reason for problemistic search.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the firm's core business and its results are still uncertain, but it is new, has a page of its own, and the firm's slack in a growing industry lets it carry the product for now.

The post-curing unit fits the firm's integrated digital manufacturing workflow and has low carrying costs given its synergy with existing systems, so it is likely retained despite only a brief web mention.
